messages:
Megan: Quick question — for the rescorer output contract, are we standardizing on raw logits or normalized probabilities for the `score` field? thinking about routing/quotas and dashboard UX.
Anya: my vote: keep raw logits in the API but expose normalized probs in the console. logits are cheaper to compute and avoid per-request softmax.
Darren: +1 on logits for internal transport, but we need a clear rule for range/scale (some models output huge magnitudes). otherwise telemetry and alerts will spike.
Megan: good point. can we add a model-metadata header like `score_scale` so console and routing can interpret?
Anya: yes — propose `score_format` enum: `logit` | `prob` | `signed_norm` and an optional `scale` float. default `logit`.
InfraBot: deploy-note: rescorer API v2 will accept `score_format` in request body and will fall back to model default when missing.
Samir: how does this interact with quota units? do we bill based on tokens, or do different score_formats imply different unit costs (e.g., extra postprocessing for probs)?
Darren: we shouldn't change billing per score format. If we add server-side softmax we can label it as an opt-in paid feature. but default remains free logits.
Lorena: console UX: if users upload a custom eval set we should show the same numbers they get from the API. so the console should request the model default `score_format` or allow override per-visualization.
Megan: makes sense. for routing decisions (latency/cost tiering) we might want a cheap, approximate `signed_norm` that maps logits to [-1,1]. That helps policies that expect bounded values.
Anya: agreed. implement `signed_norm = tanh(logit / scale)` as a recommended transform in metadata. include example in docs:
```
{"candidate_scores": [12.3, 0.5, -3.4], "score_format": "logit", "scale": 5.0}
// client can compute signed_norm = tanh(score/scale)
```
Darren: telemetry: add histogram buckets for raw logits and for normalized metrics. Also tag traces with `score_format` so we can filter regressions by transform.
Samir: landing page for rate limits: if callers ask for `score_format:prob` and we compute it server-side, mark request with header `X-Postproc: softmax` so infra can surface extra CPU.
Lorena: console action items: (1) show format badge next to model name, (2) allow per-query override, (3) surface warning if scale metadata is missing.
Megan: action items: Anya implement header + schema; Darren add telemetry tags & histograms; Samir add header to quota logs; Lorena prototype badges. I'll draft a short RFC.
Anya: I can start a tiny schema PR today.
Darren: i'll add telemetry TODO in the rerank observability board.
InfraBot: note created: RFC-2026-rescore-score-format-proposal by Megan.
Megan: thanks everyone. ping me if anything blocks — want to have a clear migration path for existing clients. :thumbsup:
